text: Planning a trip is often as exciting as the journey itself. I spent weeks researching flights, booking hostels, and circling must-see spots on a map. When I finally arrived in Vietnam, everything felt vivid and new. The bustling streets, the scent of fresh herbs, and the warmth of the locals were overwhelming in the best way. I tried dishes I couldn’t pronounce, like pho and banh mi, and learned that a smile goes further than any phrasebook. There were funny moments with language barriers—like ordering a coffee and receiving a soup—but those mistakes became my favorite memories. Travel taught me that the world is vast, yet wonderfully connected.
